release_context.first_release_context: The composition first appeared in the early DBX/Soundtracks lineage before the internationally successful Dream Version.
release_context.dreamland_presence: Dreamland contains both Children (Dream Version) and Children (Original Version) on common editions.
identity_evidence: Robert Miles Official Artist Channel publishes Children [Original Version].
Robert Miles Bandcamp publishes Children (Original Version).
MusicBrainz release data separately lists Original Version and Dream Version.

user_observation.focus: A very strange distorted sound at the beginning of the non-Dream/original version.

established: Miles described the early musical skeleton as kick, snare and a MIDI guitar.
He said the decisive later addition was a lead piano with a very marked delay.
This supports a real production distinction between the guitar/rhythm skeleton and the piano-led form that became iconic.
Miles said the first version was made soon after he bought the instrument and that the piece changed strongly over the following year.
He said he did not yet have a sampler when he made the first version.

harmony_and_tempo_crosscheck.claim_ceiling: Useful cross-transcription model, not a licensed-score authority.

reported: Kurzweil K2000 for piano and guitar sounds

children_k2000_sound_family_secondary.reported: K2000-family piano, strings, guitar and Thunder sound FX are associated with Children.
children_k2000_sound_family_secondary.boundary: This does not prove that the user's exact strange opening sound in the Original Version is specifically the K2000 Thunder preset.

original_version.role: Earlier, more club/house-oriented architecture where rhythm, pads and guitar-like/sample-like material carry more of the identity.
original_version.piano_status: The famous delayed piano is absent or not the dominant carrier in the original-version lineage according to multiple secondary descriptions; Miles's first-person account independently confirms that adding the strong-delay piano was a decisive transformation.
original_version.mechanical_effect: Without the iconic piano as the perceptual anchor, timbre and spatial FX become more exposed, so the opening can feel stranger, rougher and more synthetic.

dream_version.role: The later/hit architecture in which the delayed piano becomes the stable melodic reference frame.
dream_version.mechanical_effect: A clear tonal anchor makes the surrounding rain/thunder/pad/guitar textures read as atmosphere rather than as the main object.

intro_strange_sound_forensics.what_can_be_said_safely: The opening belongs to the pre-piano or less-piano-dominant sound world of Children, where processed synthetic/ambient and guitar-like material is perceptually exposed. The available sources support MIDI/sample-guitar, synth/sample and hardware-FX ingredients, but not one definitive patch/effect chain for the exact strange sound.

candidate_models.mechanism: A sampled/MIDI guitar timbre passed through strong delay/reverb/modulation can smear the attack, generate metallic sidebands/comb-like movement, and create an almost reversed or distorted impression.
candidate_models.support: Miles first-person account explicitly names MIDI guitar in the early skeleton; secondary gear research associates guitar with the K2000 and Lexicon effects.

candidate_models.mechanism: A thunder/ambient sample or K2000-family FX patch processed with reverb/phasing/filtering could create a coarse, non-pitched opening gesture.
candidate_models.support: Secondary sound-design sources associate Children with a Kurzweil thunder effect and reconstructions often require processed ambient FX.
candidate_models.boundary: Not proven for this exact Original-Version opening event.

candidate_models.mechanism: Reverse-envelope/time-smear processing would explain the sucking/warped perceptual quality if that is what the user is hearing.
candidate_models.support: No direct documentary support found; retained only as an audio-forensics hypothesis.

why_it_feels_distorted: The attack is less instrument-like and more texture-like than the later piano anchor.
Long hardware reverb/delay can overlap successive events and blur pitch identity.
Modulation/phasing can produce moving spectral cancellations that the ear hears as warping rather than a stable note.
If the source is a low-resolution/ROM sample or processed sample, early digital grain can become audible when exposed at the beginning.

mechanical_structure.harmonic_loop_model: Fm -> Db -> Bb -> F/Fsus-family with variations
layers: guitar-like sampled/MIDI motif as moving foreground
later Dream-Version piano as an added stable melodic anchor

psychological_mechanics.original_version: The listener enters through ambiguous texture and spatial motion before receiving a strong familiar melodic anchor; this makes the opening less reassuring and more liminal.
psychological_mechanics.dream_version: The piano quickly converts the same broad harmonic/emotional field into a legible memory-loop, making melancholy feel safe and repeatable.

janus_interpretation.role: A clean example of how one added reference layer can change the interpretation of all surrounding layers without changing the underlying identity of the work.

historical_meaning.war_children_line: Multiple accounts, including Miles-related interview material, connect the title to images of children affected by the Yugoslav wars.
historical_meaning.road_safety_line: The road-safety / post-rave calming narrative is widely repeated, but source traditions conflict on whether it was the original compositional motive; preserve it separately rather than collapse both stories.

next_gate.name: INTRO_AUDIO_FORENSICS
next_gate.best_evidence: Direct waveform/spectrogram and short-time spectral analysis of the first 10-20 seconds of the exact Original Version master, plus comparison against candidate K2000 guitar/Thunder patches and Lexicon-style modulation/reverb.

canonical_seal: IN THE ORIGINAL VERSION THE ODD TEXTURE IS EXPOSED BECAUSE THE FAMOUS PIANO ANCHOR IS NOT YET DOING THE ORIENTING WORK. THE DOCUMENTED EARLY SKELETON CONTAINS MIDI GUITAR AND RHYTHM; THE EXACT STRANGE OPENING PATCH REMAINS OPEN UNTIL DIRECT AUDIO FORENSICS.
